title: Story premise ENT044: The Ice-Cube Post Office
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: The mail route has frozen mid-sentence. Takeaway/theme: A stalled process can be restarted section by section.
description: A square courier must send three sealed parcels across a model ice shelf, but a single frozen conveyor is locked. Warm-colored fantasy tiles thaw one latch at a time, letting the conveyor advance in short sections until the parcels reach insulated nests and the courier receives a thank-you snowflake.
